name: Natural Tracker
body:
You have a natural gift for following or identifying tracks.

Prerequisite(s): Track class feature.

Benefit(s): You add your total ranger level to Survival skill checks made to follow or identify tracks. If your Survival check exceeds the DC by 10 or more, you can learn a wealth of additional information about your prey (including number and type of creatures being tracked, their physical health, condition, and general status, etc.)

Normal: A ranger adds ½ his level (minimum 1) to Survival skill checks made to follow or identify tracks.
